summary: An Open Dental-native, HIPAA-covered AI receptionist for independent practices, $199/month with no contract, sold by missed-call audits.

recommended.why: 30-60% under dental tools with PMS booking ($285-499) while keeping ~60% gross margin and LTV:CAC near 3; generic $29-129 tools lack HIPAA or PMS depth, so no need to go lower

must.feature: Real write-back booking into Open Dental
must.why: Top AI complaint: says it books but doesn't

must.feature: Warm hand-off or forward to the front desk
must.why: Reviewers value calls routed to the right person

must.feature: Signed BAA and recording plus AI disclosure
must.why: HIPAA business associate rules and state consent laws

cut.why: TCPA treats AI voices as artificial voices; consent risk for no core value
Dentrix access costs ~$10k plus royalties, 5x the budget
10DLC vetting and scope creep; text-back only

differentiator.feature: Native Open Dental booking, month to month
differentiator.why: Weave books only on qualified PMS inside a 12-month bundle; generic tools don't integrate

levers.change: Book straight into Open Dental (write API) under a signed BAA, with a warm hand-off to the front desk
levers.evidence: Users complain AI receptionists 'state they book but never do' and that Weave is 'not very compatible with Open Dental'; Open Dental sells write access at $30-35 per location

moves.why: One real, specific difference: native Open Dental booking that generic and $29 tools lack
Free text-back covers part of the job; nothing free books into a PMS under a BAA

prerequisites.what: Open Dental API developer key and write tier

levers.change: Missed-call audit outreach: call practices at lunch, then email the owner the result; first 3 pilots won locally in person
levers.evidence: 75.2% of missed dental calls are after hours and 20-38% go unanswered, so a personal audit gives a concrete hook; NPPES lists are free

moves.why: A channel exists with an estimated CAC (~$600) under first-year gross profit ($1,428)
CAC falls from ~$800 to ~$600 with a higher-reply audit hook: LTV:CAC ≈ 3.3

prerequisites.what: 5 hours a week for calls and emails

levers.change: Month-to-month with a paid 30-day pilot at $199; cancel by email
levers.evidence: Contract and cancellation complaints are the most repeated pain in Weave and Smith.ai reviews

moves.why: No contract and a paid pilot shorten the decision to about a week

levers.change: Compliance pack: BAA chain (Retell; no OpenAI or Twilio direct without BAA), recording and AI disclosure on every call, state checklist
levers.evidence: HIPAA requires BAAs with business associates; ~11 states need all-party consent; CA, TX and UT require AI disclosure

moves.why: Known compliance work, done before the first pilot

gross_margin.note: About **60%**: Retell ~$0.12/min x 450 min = $54 plus number, NexHealth, fees, 10DLC ≈ $80 per clinic

ltv_cac.note: CAC falls from ~$800 to ~$600 with a higher-reply audit hook: LTV:CAC ≈ 3.3

pricing_power.note: $199 fills the gap: generic tools lack HIPAA (ElevenLabs) or PMS depth; dental AI starts at **$299-499**

build_effort.note: Voice stack is off the shelf (Retell); PMS write booking and HIPAA setup take 1-2 months at 10 h/week

skills_match.note: Developer can build it; HIPAA compliance and selling to dentists are skills the founder lacks

capital_needed.note: Fits $2,000 with Retell BAA and Open Dental; Dentrix ($10k) or a Vapi HIPAA add-on would not

time_to_mvp.note: About 8 weeks to a booking-capable, BAA-covered pilot at 10 h/week (estimate)

sales_cycle.note: No contract and a paid pilot shorten the decision to about a week

channel_readiness.note: A channel exists with an estimated CAC (~$600) under first-year gross profit ($1,428)

search_demand.note: 135,665 dental offices (CBP 2023); Dentaltown ~255k members discuss missed calls

trend.note: Healthcare AI voice agents grow **37.8%/yr** (GVR); RingCentral AI receptionist 5.9x in 11 months

willingness_to_pay.note: Practices pay $175-700/month for human answering and Weave's median customer $12.5k/year

free_alternatives.note: Free text-back covers part of the job; nothing free books into a PMS under a BAA

competitor_density.note: R3/R5: 15+ rivals and 10 look-alike launches in 12 months; Weave serves 40,000+ locations

differentiation.note: One real, specific difference: native Open Dental booking that generic and $29 tools lack

legal_regulatory.note: Known compliance work, done before the first pilot

platform_dependency.note: Booking needs PMS access (Open Dental $30-35, NexHealth); OpenAI BAAs case by case; Twilio BAA needs Security Edition

market_risk.note: Missed calls are a durable need (75% after hours), but incumbents are absorbing the feature

skills.note: Builds software; no healthcare compliance or B2B dental sales track record

assets.note: No dental network, audience or data (stated)

interest.note: Stated goal is a side business at $5k MRR: money first, no dental interest stated

rules_applied.effect: saturated_wave -> competitor_density 1; legal_platform_risk -> legal 2.5; strong_competitor -> density <= 3

ltv_cac.reasoning: LTV $1,987 / CAC ~$600 with the audit hook = 3.3

blockers: Founder fit: no dental network, no healthcare compliance track record, 10 h/week (fit 1.7 of 5)
A saturated field: Weave (40,000+ locations, ADA-endorsed) and 15+ rivals keep competitor density at 1
Legal and platform exposure stays: HIPAA chain, state AI-disclosure laws and PMS access cap risk near 2.8
Time to MVP stays ~8 weeks at 10 h/week; a team or full-time founder would move it

plan.step: Run the 7-day missed-call audit test: 40 calls, 150 emails, 5 demos
plan.verify: 2 or more paid $199 pilots or signed letters of intent

plan.step: Sign the Retell BAA, get an Open Dental developer key, write the compliance pack
plan.verify: BAA signed and test booking written into an Open Dental sandbox

plan.step: Build the Open Dental booking agent and onboard the pilots
plan.verify: 95% of AI bookings correct over 100 test calls

plan.step: Audit outreach at 300 emails a week
plan.verify: 5 paying clinics, under 20% call hang-up rate

plan.step: Review churn and CAC; pitch 1 dental agency for white-label

kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 paid pilots from the audit test by 2026-11-20 -> stop
AI booking accuracy under 90% on 100 test calls by 2027-01-15 -> stop or go request-only
Fewer than 5 paying clinics by 2027-02-28 -> stop
Monthly churn above 10% across 10+ clinics by 2027-05-31 -> stop
